reason: After #987, archiving a project's only chat retires its execution worker, and a later unarchive (PATCH /api/v1/chat-sessions/{id} {"archived": false}) stayed queued until another chat message admitted the project, because ingress did not classify the unarchive as a chat start. The unarchive PATCH is now a chat-start intent, and the legacy queued-command scan promotes an older unclassified unarchive only when the named chat belongs to the command's project. Selection covers the classifier (positive, negative and malformed bodies), the unchanged session-creation intents, exact-project admission, archive retirement, unarchive admission through real API ingress, RuntimeRouting, retirement and auto-admission without a message, legacy promotion for the exact chat project, and the refactored legacy goal-conversation promotion. Rebased onto #1028 (queued project commands admit their worker): test_project_admission_requires_a_chat_start_or_queued_project_command (renamed from ..._requires_an_exact_chat_start) now expects a legacy ordinary command to admit its project like a chat start, while reads and barriers still do not; the legacy-unarchive test still requires promotion only for the chat's own project and now also checks that each project's owner claims only its own head. #1028's three admission tests are selected to guard the combined behaviour.
exclusions: tests/v3/test_chat_unarchive_readmission.py (real Core: first chat, archive, real retirement, unarchive) is not selected: its shared Core fixture needs the already-cached local embedding model and a host name that resolves to a non-loopback LAN address, which CI does not have, so it now skips with that reason instead of erroring. It passed locally on Python 3.12 against this rebased branch (see the PR). No UI, native or frontend code changed, so no frontend, native or Playwright tests; the UI journey was checked in desktop Chromium and phone WebKit against a scratch supervisor Core (see the PR). PostgreSQL parametrizations are collected but skip in CI because these files are not in the workflow's PostgreSQL list; they pass locally on PostgreSQL 16. No live or staging Core mutation, database backup, or deployment.
